ATLASSIAN_SEATRIALS_AUTH.title: Atlassian MCP Authorization header (Sea Trials)
ATLASSIAN_SEATRIALS_AUTH.description: Authorization header value for seatrials. Prefer setting it in Cursor Dashboard > Integrations & MCP > Team MCP Servers > Edit mcp.json (no per-device OAuth). Service account: 'Bearer <api_key>'. Requires an Atlassian org admin to enable API-token auth for the Rovo MCP server. Team Marketplace has no Plugins > Configure surface for this variable today.
